paper.title: Learning ground states of quantum Hamiltonians with graph networks
paper.authors: Dmitrii Kochkov, Tobias Pfaff, Alvaro Sanchez-Gonzalez, Peter Battaglia, Bryan K. Clark

results.system_description: J₁–J₂ Heisenberg, 6 × 6 · J₂/J₁ = 0.5 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J1 sum_<ij> S_i · S_j + J2 sum_<<ij>> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S = sigma/2; J1 = 1; J2 = 0.5; no constant shift
results.source_location: Appendix, Table "Numerical values of variational energies per spin" (table:energies), row Square, J2 = 0.5, N = 36, column GNN
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per spin of the optimized state, estimated by Markov-chain Monte Carlo with 2 x 10^5 samples from equilibrated chains, with the stochastic error in parentheses (appendix, Model performance).
results.notes: Hamiltonian H = sum_<ij> S_i S_j + J2 sum_<<ij>> S_i S_j with spin-1/2 operators and J1 = 1 (Sec. Methods); periodic clusters of the appendix table of cluster vectors (table:lattices_apx). Sampling uses spin-exchange moves, which conserve the total Sz; the Sz of the initial configurations is not stated. Optimized by imaginary-time supervised wave-function optimization (IT-SWO); the recorded value is a directly evaluated variational energy.
